sources.title: NadavSalem/Titanius-1-115m-sft-fp16-preview · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is an early preview based on a base model trained for only 7,000 steps and then SFT-trained for 1,000 steps. No benchmark, validation-set, safety, bias, memorization, or instruction-following evaluation is reported.
